order: Execution Order: Revision of the Entry-State Indicator (6 October 2026), section 3
rule: yearly closing highs over the lookback; a ceiling exists when at least two lie within 5% of each other, at least six months apart, each followed by a decline of at least 10% within three months (63 sessions; for the current year's high, the decline so far). The ceiling is the higher of the two. The flag is set when the close is within 15% below the ceiling and caps the state at WATCH until a close above it
lookback_note: the order says 'the last 10 years'; its own reference (Incyte's September 2015 high) lies eleven years back, so the lookback covers the current calendar year and the eleven before it
prices: split-adjusted daily closes as charted (yfinance auto_adjust=False, full history)
